# awscc_quicksight_space (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::QuickSight::Space



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the space.
- `aws_account_id` (String) The ID of the Amazon Web Services account where the space is being created.
- `created_at` (String) The date and time the space was created.
- `created_by` (String) The user name of the principal who created the space.
- `description` (String) A description of the space.
- `name` (String) The display name of the space.
- `permissions` (Attributes List) A list of permissions granted on the space. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `resources` (Attributes List) A list of QuickSight resources attached to the space. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `space_id` (String) The unique identifier for the space.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of key-value pairs to associate with the space resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time the space was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `actions` (List of String) The list of actions granted to the principal.
- `principal` (String) The ARN of the principal (user or group) receiving the permission.


<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `resource_arn` (String) The ARN of the QuickSight resource.
- `resource_type` (String) The type of QuickSight resource.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.
